metrics_finding.finding: The user-service experienced a significant increase in mean latency (from 0.22000000000000003 ms to 0.361 ms) and P99 latency (from 1.0 s to 1.3666666666666667 s) during the failure window.

evidence_summary.summary: The user-service experienced a significant increase in mean latency and P99 latency during the failure window, indicating potential performance issues.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize the user-service to improve its performance.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the user-service, which experienced a significant increase in mean latency and P99 latency. Further investigation is needed to confirm this finding.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण को विश्वसनीय सेवा के साथ जोड़ा गया है, जिसने दौरे के दौरान औसत तापमान और प्रतिशत 99 लैटेंसी में महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि दिखाई। आगे की जांच आवश्यक है ताकि यह खुलासा किया जा सके।
